body:
AMEND — admission and stage-order wording only; this does not block the documentation candidate.

I checked the pinned summary against exact candidate `cand-7MEX4N9K5PVNQS7C32XCWVNX3H` / commit `f203b783...` and the cited primary records. The candidate paragraph is accurate only as a documentation-landing statement: both reviews approve, Mote derives only `authorization_absent`, Git still shows the commit is not on `main`, and the reviews explicitly confer no source, package, runtime, or higher-gate authority.

Please amend these sentences in a superseding summary:

- Rename `B0 OWNER-ONLY GATE` to `OWNER-ONLY ACTIONS WITHIN DOCUMENTATION-ONLY B0`. “Owner closes B0 decisions” must not imply those actions alone close B0. Likewise, “promotes P1” is not P1 completion. C1 still waits for independently completed P1 and closed B0.
- Replace “F1 admitted BBB excerpt plus pinned LGPL FFmpeg and weightless PySceneDetect next.” No exact BBB file/excerpt is presently admitted. Say: after the staged plan reaches a separately authorized acquisition court, use project-authored F0 first; then one exact BBB F1 excerpt only after file/excerpt hashes, CC BY 3.0 attribution, and a derivation/admission record, with a realized exact preferably-LGPL-only FFmpeg configuration whose required decoders, patent posture, native closure, and digests are admitted, plus an exact learned-checkpoint-free PySceneDetect `ContentDetector` runtime. “Weightless” is inaccurate because `ContentDetector` has numeric component weights; the established claim is no learned checkpoint. Primary records: [BBB](https://peach.blender.org/about/), [FFmpeg legal](https://ffmpeg.org/legal.html), [exact ContentDetector](https://github.com/Breakthrough/PySceneDetect/blob/6ebb72392de8acfb6c539bf15d0aa912ce7ab6b2/scenedetect/detectors/content_detector.py).
- State the global order explicitly: P1 and B0 close -> C1 -> D0/D1 -> E0. F0/F1/F2 are evidence tiers inside separately authorized courts, not implementation stages or permission to skip stages. No exact lawful source-film plus human-recall F2 pair is admitted.
- “Sherlock artifact license” is too narrow: the hold covers exact source admission, blank pinned dataset licence metadata, the unlicensed workbook repository, and the separately governed BBC episode. MF2 owner approval would cover the NC-SA benchmark use only, not underlying film or subtitle rights; FilmFestival also retains edition, omitted-film, companion-repository, participant-content, and REB holds. Primary records: [Sherlock metadata](https://github.com/OpenNeuroDatasets/ds001132/blob/master/dataset_description.json), [FilmFestival deposit](https://github.com/OpenNeuroDatasets/ds004042), [MF2 release](https://github.com/deep-spin/MF2).

Disposition: AMEND the pinned summary before using its order as authorization. The existing no-download/no-terms/no-participant-content sentence remains correct.
